overview: The City Council approved a new hazard mitigation plan and promoted recovery services for veterans, but tabled a $250,000 housing appropriation pending broader budget discussions.

items.title: Commemoration of Mimi Gordon
items.summary: The council approved a resolution honoring the life and community service of Mimi Gordon, a long-time local activist and union representative.

items.title: Promotion of First Responder and Veteran Recovery Group
items.summary: Approved a resolution to promote weekly recovery meetings for first responders and veterans dealing with substance use and mental health disorders.

items.title: Records and Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved various committee records and reports covering zoning, preliminary budget presentations, and public surveillance reports.

items.title: Welcoming City Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Referred proposed amendments to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee to examine potential reporting and feasibility issues.

items.title: Urban Forestry Management Plan Review
items.summary: Referred the 175-page management plan to the Public Works and Facilities Committee to evaluate legislative and budgetary recommendations.

items.title: Fractional Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: The public hearing regarding affordable unit value benchmarks was continued to July 14th because the state benchmark is no longer being updated.

items.title: Free Cash Appropriation for Affordable Housing Trust
items.summary: Tabled a request for $250,000 for the Affordable Housing Trust after councilors expressed concern about approving individual free cash items before receiving the full municipal budget and year-end reports.

items.title: Auto Sales and Repair Licenses
items.summary: Approved Class 1 and Class 4 licenses for Herb Chambers Toyota at 400 Mystic Avenue, with the petitioner agreeing to investigate road quality issues on the adjacent private way.

items.title: Do Not Knock Registry Amendments
items.summary: Referred a proposal to update solicitor registry procedures and enforcement liability to the Subcommittee on Licensing, Permitting, and Signs.

items.title: Routine Business: Board Appointments and Donations
items.summary: Approved appointments to the Community Garden Commission, Affordable Housing Trust, and Zoning Board of Appeals, and accepted a $1,000 donation from Stop and Shop.

items.title: Adoption of Hazard Mitigation Plan 2025
items.summary: Approved the updated five-year roadmap for disaster risk reduction, which maintains city eligibility for federal mitigation grants through 2030.

items.title: Tree Warden Reclassification
items.summary: Approved increasing the Tree Warden position to 40 hours per week at a higher pay grade to attract a licensed arborist and head the Forestry Division.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident expressed concern regarding the lack of a city plan for immigration enforcement and addressed recent national incidents of Islamophobia.
